<!-- PR title = squash commit message. Use a Conventional Commit: feat(orders): cancel an order -->
<!-- Episode 1's template had a checklist. This one is written for the person who reviews: four sections are required
     and checked by the pr-description job; delete the comments, write your own words. -->

## What and why
<!-- The change in two sentences, and the reason it's needed now. Link the issue or work item. -->

## How to verify
<!-- Commands, requests or clicks that show it works, and the tests you added. -->

## Where to look
<!-- The files that matter and what to read first. Say what is mechanical (renames, generated code) so nobody reads it line by line. -->

## Risk and rollback
<!-- What can this break, for whom, and how do we undo it? Schema or contract changes go here. -->

## Out of scope
<!-- Optional. What you deliberately did not do, so nobody has to ask. -->
